purpose: Reusable internal registry for separating static/dynamic and scalar/vector descriptor layers without renaming formal paper terms.

classification_rules.scalar_static: A fixed admissible configuration p is mapped to one real value; no explicit time variable is present.
classification_rules.vector_static: A fixed admissible configuration p is mapped to an ordered finite vector in R^m, m>=2; no explicit time variable is present.
classification_rules.scalar_static_projection: A scalar_static descriptor formed by applying a declared projection to a vector_static descriptor or channel tuple.
classification_rules.scalar_dynamic: A scalar aggregate or scalar parameter indexed by time or used as a time-dependent dynamical quantity.
classification_rules.scalar_field_dynamic: A time-dependent field with scalar value at each local point, such as alpha(x,t).
classification_rules.vector_dynamic: A time-dependent vector-valued descriptor or coupled multi-channel state. No implemented instance is currently registered.
